parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~144489~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The list of instance IDs. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) operation to query instance IDs.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of the tag. > N specifies the sequence number of the tag key. For example:
  • Tag.1.Key specifies the key of the first tag.
  • Tag.2.Key specifies the key of the second tag.
.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The value of the tag. > N specifies the sequence number of the tag value. For example:
  • Tag.1.Value specifies the value of the first tag.
  • Tag.2.Value specifies the value of the second tag.
.
